title: Win 10 built-in Stick Notes app does not return to specified zones after screen waking

status.label: Fix plan ready for design
status.detail: A focused monitor-wake reproduction can test FancyZones restore against stale bounds.

next_action.label: Design fix
next_action.reason: Trace monitor/work-area state while restoring Sticky Notes after wake.

judgment.rationale: The report provides setting, app/version, monitor type, and wake trigger; a stale display/work-area snapshot is a testable but unconfirmed hypothesis.
evidence: On an ultrawide primary display, Sticky Notes windows shift right/behind other windows after wake, while other apps return correctly.
Only comment is bot similarity links #18103 and #13802; both are closed and neither establishes a fix here.
judgment.recommended_action: Reproduce the display-wake sequence and trace FancyZones restore against current monitor/work-area state.

fix_assessment.rationale: No linked fix or active owner covers this Sticky Notes/ultrawide wake report.

proposed_fixes.title: Restore Sticky Notes against post-wake monitor bounds
proposed_fixes.root_cause: FancyZones may apply a pre-sleep monitor/work-area snapshot when restoring Sticky Notes after wake, leaving those windows outside the visible work area.
plan: Reproduce with keep-in-zone enabled and record monitor topology and Notes window bounds before/after wake.
Trace FancyZones display-change and resume restoration for stale/out-of-range bounds.
Refresh or validate the target work area before applying saved zone placement.
Add coverage for a returning display and windows reporting pre-wake bounds.
verification: Wake the ultrawide display and confirm individual Notes and list windows return to their zones.
Confirm other zoned windows remain visible and correctly placed.

confidence.rationale: The timing and app-specific behavior fit stale restore state, but no trace confirms whether FancyZones, Sticky Notes, or Windows supplies the shifted bounds.

issue_context.summary: Sticky Notes windows on an ultrawide primary display shift right and become obscured after wake although FancyZones is configured to keep windows in zones.
known_information: PowerToys 0.80.1, Sticky Notes 6.0.2.0, setting enabled, ultrawide primary display.
Both individual Notes and the notes-list window are affected; other applications reportedly restore correctly.
Bot linked #18103 and #13802; those are closed and do not establish resolution of this report.
inferences: Stale display geometry or an app-specific bounds report may explain the shift; cause is unconfirmed.
issue_context.analysis: The specific setup and transition justify a maintainer-side reproduction rather than a generic reporter log request.
initial_investigation: Reviewed body and sole bot comment through 2024-04-12T09:34:22Z; no maintainer follow-up.
Checked linked similar issues #18103 and #13802; neither supplies evidence of a fix here.
Product-FancyZones indicates ownership; no assignee or linked fix.

actions.label: Design fix
actions.note: Approve a focused FancyZones investigation; no upstream write.

actions.label: Reproduce Sticky Notes after display wake

reproduce.title: Check Sticky Notes zone restore after ultrawide wake
reproduce.version_requirement: Current development build; compare 0.80.1 if available
prerequisites: Enable keep-windows-in-zones when resolution/work area changes
setup: Place individual Notes and notes-list windows in FancyZones zones before sleep.
steps: Allow the display to sleep and wake without changing the layout.
Check the Notes windows and compare with other zoned applications.
reproduce.expected_result: All Notes windows return to their assigned visible zones; none shift behind other windows or outside the display.
